_what: What approving a tool for a space's members would give each of them beyond what they already hold (src/access-impact.mjs). `reaches` are rows read off the tool's descriptor: when a row's path holds `equals` (or any value when `present`), the row's words are told to the owner, and a row with decided_by owner means the space owner has to decide it themselves. A new kind of consequence is a row here, not code.

reaches.says: It runs on a member's own computer.
It sends what it is given off the member's device.
Running it can cost the member money.
Members can read what it produced.

words.no_gain: Everyone it would reach already holds this.
words.later_members: It also reaches whoever joins later.
